ops.en: THE HEADER [EX01-13]. ve-ELE shemot bene yisrael — 'and THESE are the names': the vav of the opening CONNECTS (the readings: the and- word adds to the first matter — gen_69's seventy-ledger reopened verbatim across the book-boundary, the watchlist's first armed verse landing); the machine files the restraint it learned at the ledger (REGISTRY untouched — the roster lists, it does not install); the…

THE FIRST COLUMN. reuven shimon levi vi-yhuda — four names, one verse, no verbs: the machine holds the roster as PRECONDITION (the persons are gen_51's registry, not this unit's); the readings' twelve-pillars figure on the vav-to-vav opening named at the header [EX01-13]: the names the decree will try to erase are laid out first, in the birth-order the corpus derived.

THE SECOND COLUMN. yisashkhar zevulun u-venyamin — Leah's file closes and Rachel's ONE living-in-Canaan son stands alone (Joseph is already below, 1:5): the machine notes the ledger's silent asymmetry — the column of three where the mothers' arithmetic once ruled the house (gen_51's four mothers): the roster compresses a book of births into three verses.

THE THIRD COLUMN. dan ve-naftali gad ve-asher — the handmaids' four close the roster in gen_69's own ledger-order (Bilhah's pair, Zilpah's pair): eleven names counted; the machine files the missing twelfth as the next verse's hinge — the ledger knows where Joseph is.

THE COUNT [gen_69's ledger]. kol nefesh yotze yerekh yaaqov SHIVIM nafesh — the SEVENTY re-attested across the book-boundary (46:27's census, the number Egypt wept for seventy days, gen_73): the corpus's ledger and this header agree to the digit; ve-YOSEF haya ve-mitzrayim — 'and Joseph WAS in Egypt': the readings hear the standing-fact — he was already there, the same Joseph, righteous below as a…

THE RETELLING. va-YAMAT yosef — the death the machine already recorded (gen_73's EVENT at 50:26) RETOLD, not re-installed: the machine holds the recap as precondition and files the care-point — a generation's whole passing in one verse (ve-khol ha-dor ha-hu): the letter clears the stage so that 1:8's not-knowing has something to not know; no second death-event enters the world (the one-world law: …

THE SCHEME [EX01-06]. HAVA nitchakma LO — 'COME, let us deal WISELY with him': the hava-cohortative (Babel's own let-us grammar, gen_25's tower) pushes the court's collective demand — the machine records the state scheming against a singular 'him' (the readings' twelve-gematria named [EX01-13]); pen YIRBE — 'LEST HE MULTIPLY': the king legislates against 1:7's verbs; ve-NOSAF gam hu al sonenu — 'a…

THE PERFORMANCE [EX01-03; EX01-07]. va-YASIMU alav sare misim — 'they SET over him taskmasters of levies': the court's let-us-deal- wisely is DONE — the demand pops in the deed-verse (the machine notes what the pop buys: the DEED, not the goal — the goal inverts next verse); lemaan ANOTO be-sivlotam — 'to AFFLICT him with their burdens': the afflict-word's ONE Torah token, its Amnon-pair named (th…

THE SERVICE [EX01-13]. va-YAAVIDU mitzrayim et bene yisrael be- FAREKH — the serve-verb in the causative: EGYPT (the whole nation, not the crown alone — the readings note the subject) makes Israel SERVE; be-farekh — 'with CRUSHING service': the readings' soft-mouth reading carried named (be-FE RAKH — the enslavement opened as invitation, Sota's file [EX01-13]); the machine notes the covenant's own…

THE BITTERNESS [EX01-11]. va-YEMARERU et chayehem — 'they made their lives BITTER' (the resh on its simple sheva, MS's pointing asserted): the readings count the verse's FOUR afflictions (hard service / mortar-and-bricks / field-service / the crushing all) with the plague-arithmetic named (each plague four — the ten armed); be- CHOMER — the MORTAR written LEAN, the 248-limbs reading named, and the…

THE TWO NAMES [EX01-01; EX01-13]. la-MEYALDOT ha-ivriyot — the midwife-word entering its chapter LEAN, as the whole Torah writes it (the marquee's file, next verse's decree the reason the file matters); asher SHEM ha-achat SHIFRA ve-shem ha-shenit PUA — the letter does what the decree cannot prevent: it NAMES them (the readings' identifications and the reed-pipe reading carried named [EX01-13]) — …
